title: Chicago Fire FC Commemorative Ticket — Match Config
description: Team-managed match info that drives the commemorative ticket feature. Edited directly in this repo (via the GitHub web UI or a PR) whenever match details change or a new match should be featured.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema, for future migrations. Leave as "1.0" unless the structure changes.

lastUpdated.description: Optional. ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit, for editors' own reference. Not used by the app logic.

id.description: Unique slug for this match, e.g. "2026-08-23-chi-vs-nycfc". Used internally (e.g. as part of the generated filename) — not shown to users.

name.description: Full opponent club name as it should display on the ticket, e.g. "New York City FC".

shortName.description: Optional abbreviation for tight layouts, e.g. "NYCFC".

logoUrl.description: Relative path to the opponent's logo image, e.g. "assets/logos/nycfc.png". Recommended: transparent PNG or SVG, square-ish crop.

isHome.description: True if this is a Chicago Fire FC home match. Controls "vs." / "@" display and which club logo appears first.

backgroundImageUrl.description: Optional. Relative path to a venue photo/illustration used as ticket background art, if the design calls for a venue-specific background.

date.description: Match date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), local to the venue, e.g. "2026-08-23".

kickoffTime.description: Kickoff time in 24-hour HH:MM, local to the venue, e.g. "19:30".

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the venue, e.g. "America/Chicago". Used to format the displayed date/time correctly regardless of the fan's own device timezone.

competition.description: Optional competition label, e.g. "MLS Regular Season", "U.S. Open Cup", "Leagues Cup".

ticketTemplateVariant.description: Optional. Selects the ticket art variant. Supported: "default" (split red/navy banner header with classic tear-off footer) and "wireframe" (the original plain layout). Omit, or use any other value, to get the default template.
